title: elaeocarpus submonoceras subsp. oxypyren
intro: Elaeocarpus submonoceras subsp. oxypyren, commonly known as a species of flowering plant, is a member of the Elaeocarpaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as analgesic, anti-diarrheal, and anti-viral effects. However, more research is needed to fully understand the potential therapeutic uses of this plant.
